name: Character Creation + Game HUD
description: Message renderer with interactive character creation form on greeting (messageIndex 0), then switches to a game state HUD with tabbed panels for subsequent messages. Demonstrates: form-based greeting interaction, multi-tab state panels, variable-driven stat bars, CSS animations, stamp/approval effects, inventory/skill list rendering.

requires.notes: String variables for player identity choices. Number variables for stats. JSON arrays for inventory and skills. The greeting entry should set up the character creation narrative.

author: yumina-official
